fields: as a table: cols, rows (cells strings or {t, link}), fold, fold_noun (nav is the page-nav label, not printed), and optional art (look-only): per row, one station key per "where the water goes" item ("proof", "batch", "lab", "boiler", "line"). Without art each item picks its station from its words (proofing, laboratory or lab, boiler, product lines or touches the product, else a batch kettle).
best_for: ScenePlates sets a table of plants (or any uses) as a ruled ledger beside one navy drawing plate: the plant you point at, focus or choose is drawn on the plate as one water header with a drop to each of its points of use, numbered as the ledger's "where the water goes" list.
